name: Nexstair AI
tagline: AI assistant, website chatbot and SEO audit in one platform
description: Nexstair AI brings three tools that small businesses usually buy separately into a single platform. The AI assistant handles internal tasks such as drafting content briefs, summarising information before a sales conversation, and keeping company wording consistent. The AI chatbot sits on a website, answers common questions at any hour, captures what visitors are asking, and hands a conversation to a person when it should. The SEO audit report gives a clear view of technical and content issues on a site, so the team knows what to fix first.
